title: Grimoire Archive: Progression
summary: Use Grimoire progression to move from field notes into forbidden knowledge carefully.

blocks.title: Early Archives
blocks.body: Start with Aether Signal, resonance, Veil pressure, unknown relics, ritual stability, spell schools, and curse stages.

blocks.title: Middle Archives
blocks.body: Use generated bridge entries for relics, rituals, research, entities, landmarks, and boss gates as the route expands.

blocks.title: Late Archives
blocks.body: Treat forbidden records as decisions. They should ask whether the player is prepared for consequence, not merely whether the item exists.

blocks.title: Upgrade Check
blocks.body: Do not raise the risk until the current upgrade tier works without emergency improvising.
